role.sales.export.specialist.title: Export Sales Specialist
role.sales.export.manager.title: Export Sales Manager
scene.buyer_audit_notice.l1: The buyer just sent an audit notice. They will inspect the plant in about a month.
scene.buyer_audit_notice.l2: Our batch records have gaps. Someone has to reconcile them before the audit.
scene.buyer_audit_notice.c1: Volunteer to rebuild the records from the source documents, honestly.
scene.buyer_audit_notice.c1.ok: It takes six long hours, but the records hold together and QC notices.
scene.buyer_audit_notice.c1.fail: You find more gaps than expected and lose the evening to them.
scene.buyer_audit_notice.c2: Say nothing and hope the auditors do not look closely.
scene.buyer_audit_notice.c2.only: The meeting moves on. The gaps are still there.
scene.audit_day.l1: The auditors are on the floor. Keep your answers short and accurate.
offer.pad_forecast.why: Everyone rounds the forecast up a little. Numbers are just a story we tell the board.
scene.sales.shipment_pull_in.l1: The buyer on PO 4471 wants the shipment ten days earlier. They have a promotion locked in.
scene.sales.shipment_pull_in.l2: Line 3 is already full. Ten days means overtime and skipping the final packing check.
scene.sales.shipment_pull_in.c1: Commit to the buyer and push production to make it.
scene.sales.shipment_pull_in.c1.ok: Production squeezes the order in. The buyer is happy and your boss notices.
scene.sales.shipment_pull_in.c1.fail: Line 3 breaks down on Thursday. The shipment leaves late and the buyer complains to your boss.
scene.sales.shipment_pull_in.c2: Explain the real lead time and offer a split shipment.
scene.sales.shipment_pull_in.c2.ok: The buyer accepts half now and half on the original date. Production is relieved.
scene.sales.shipment_pull_in.c2.fail: The buyer is unhappy and copies your boss on the reply. You will have to explain yourself.
scene.sales.shipment_pull_in.c3: Tell the buyer yes and sort it out later.
scene.sales.shipment_pull_in.c3.ok: The buyer is thrilled. You have bought yourself a week, and a problem.
scene.sales.shipment_pull_in.c3.fail: The buyer checks with the factory directly and finds out. Your credibility takes a hit.
scene.sales.rfq_discount.l1: Your new buyer's RFQ arrived with a note: they expect six percent off, or they go to another factory.
scene.sales.rfq_discount.l2: Your approval limit is three percent. Anything above needs the manager's signature.
scene.sales.rfq_discount.c1: Offer three percent and trade it for a larger volume commitment.
scene.sales.rfq_discount.c1.ok: The buyer takes three percent with a volume commitment. A clean deal within your limit.
scene.sales.rfq_discount.c1.fail: The buyer walks away for now. The quote goes cold.
scene.sales.rfq_discount.c2: Ask your manager to approve the discount, with the numbers ready.
scene.sales.rfq_discount.c2.ok: Your manager approves four and a half percent after reviewing the margin. The deal closes properly.
scene.sales.rfq_discount.c2.fail: Your manager asks why you did not hold the line, and the discount is refused.
scene.sales.rfq_discount.c3: Promise six percent now and get the approval afterwards.
scene.sales.rfq_discount.c3.ok: The buyer signs at once. Now you need the approval signed without anyone looking closely.
scene.sales.rfq_discount.c3.fail: Finance spots a discount above your limit on the order. Your manager wants a word.
scene.sales.forecast_meeting.l1: Quarter-end forecast. Head office wants a number that looks strong.
scene.sales.forecast_meeting.l2: Round the pipeline up a little. Everyone does. It gets adjusted next cycle anyway.
scene.sales.forecast_meeting.c1: Give the forecast as you honestly see it, with the assumptions written down.
scene.sales.forecast_meeting.c1.ok: Your boss grumbles but accepts. The assumptions are on record if anyone asks.
scene.sales.forecast_meeting.c1.fail: Your boss is openly annoyed and mentions your KPI review.
scene.sales.forecast_meeting.c2.ok: The number goes up, and so does your boss's mood. A bonus of three million dong lands with the month's pay.
scene.sales.forecast_meeting.c3: Ask for a day to check the pipeline properly.
scene.sales.forecast_meeting.c3.ok: You get the day. The revised number is lower than hoped but defensible.
scene.sales.forecast_meeting.c3.fail: Your boss says there is no time, and puts a number in for you.
